spells/rebirth-of-iron-881.name: Rebirth of Iron
spells/rebirth-of-iron-881.effectSummary: Instantly restores a single metal object damaged or destroyed by rust, even if it has been reduced to powder. If part of the object is missing, at least one-quarter of it must remain. The spell restores only physical form: it does not restore the magical properties of a magic item or construct, and a destroyed metallic creature is restored physically but remains dead and without its magical qualities.

provenance.role: Complete Mage primary effect and header reviewed; rust restoration, powder recovery, one-quarter remainder threshold, non-restoration of magic and physical-only metallic-creature restoration preserved
